title: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI has a heap buffer over-read in a QueueManager… (CVE-2026-130290)
description: Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) versions before 5.2.0 contain a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in the RXAPI component's QueueManager DataQueue::add method. The issue arises because the code trusts the client-supplied message.parameter1 value as the size for copying data from a heap buffer, which can lead to reading beyond the buffer boundary. An attacker can exploit this by sending a large parameter1 value in specific queue messages, potentially causing a process crash.
